methodologyNote: Core entries are source-compared editorial summaries of contemporary Lenormand practice; expert review is still pending. The 1799 Game of Hope source documents a game and a playful oracle layout, not this glossary of fixed divinatory meanings.

sources.title: Humoristische Blätter für Kopf und Herz (1799), containing Das Spiel der Hoffnung
sources.scope: Deck/game provenance and historical oracle-layout context only; not a source for the modern card keyword glossary or fixed pair doctrine.

sources.title: Learn Lenormand Card Meanings in Depth
sources.scope: Contemporary keywords for all 36 cards; author-specific interpretations, not historical proof.

sources.title: The Cross (36)
sources.scope: Cross meanings and acknowledged contemporary spiritual/destiny variants.

sources.title: Lenormand Crossroads Meanings and Combinations
sources.scope: Paths/Roads meanings: choices, alternatives, options, and decisions.

sources.title: Accurate Fox Meanings and Combinations
sources.scope: Fox has work/employment and cunning/deception readings; context matters.

sources.title: The Lily (30)
sources.scope: Maturity, experience, peace, and a tradition-dependent sexuality interpretation.

sources.title: The Fish (34)
sources.scope: Money, assets, business, trade, and resources; some secondary readings extend this to independence or flow.
